title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 138
paragraphs: This moreover has also been the case with them, which the Persians themselves have failed to notice but I have not: their names, which are formed to correspond with their bodily shapes or the magnificence of their station, all end with the same letter — the letter which the Dorians call “san” and the Ionians “sigma.” If you examine the matter, you will find that all the Persian names end with this letter, not some with this and others with other letters, but all alike.
